title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 7) Order 2005

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 7) Order 2005.

2. ElectroTech Investments Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on the foreign dividends received in Singapore from its wholly owned Netherlands and Malaysian subsidiaries, from 10th October 2005 to 9th October 2010 (both dates inclusive), subject to the conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 10th October 2005 addressed to the tax adviser of ElectroTech Investments Ltd, PricewaterhouseCoopers Services Pte Ltd.
